**Job Description**
**Product Analyst, Lynks / Integration Catalog**
**Role Summary**
 The Product Analyst, Lynks / Integration Catalog will support the growth and operational execution of LynkUp, UPS Digital’s integration platform for connecting UPS capabilities, third\-party systems, and partner/customer platforms into reusable solution components.
   

  

 Within LynkUp, a “Lynk” is a reusable integration or endpoint that can be used across UPS Digital solutions. These Lynks may include third\-party carrier integrations, ERP / OMS / WMS / TMS system integrations, partner platform connections, or UPS product “action” endpoints such as Delivery Intercept, InsureShield, or other capabilities that can be assembled into customer solutions.
   

  

 This role will help move Lynks from idea to usable catalog capability. The analyst will support intake, discovery, requirements, external coordination, testing, UAT, roadmap tracking, and business enablement. This is an individual contributor role, but it requires strong project management, follow\-through, and comfort coordinating across UPS product teams, engineering teams, commercial sponsors, customers, carriers, and external technology contacts.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage intake for new Lynk / integration requests from product, commercial, customer, carrier, partner, and internal solution sponsors.
* Support discovery to clarify the business problem, customer use case, integration need, expected value, technical dependency, and adoption path.
* Help determine whether a requested integration should become a reusable Lynk in the catalog versus a one\-off customer or solution\-specific integration.
* Identify and coordinate with the right external contacts at carriers, customers, technology platforms, or partner organizations to obtain credentials, technical documentation, sandbox access, test data, and other integration inputs.
* Coordinate integration delivery activities across UPS product, engineering, architecture, commercial, customer, and third\-party teams.
* Translate business and integration needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, testing needs, and handoff materials for engineering.
* Support integration testing and UAT, including defining test scenarios, coordinating test execution, tracking defects, validating expected outcomes, and confirming readiness for business use.
* Maintain the Lynks roadmap, integration inventory, ownership, status, dependencies, documentation, and availability.
* Support prioritization of Lynks across carrier integrations, ERP / OMS / WMS / TMS systems, marketplaces, partner platforms, and UPS internal action endpoints.
* Communicate newly available Lynks to product, sales, solutions, and business stakeholders, including what the Lynk does, why it matters, where it can be used, and how teams should engage.
* Follow up with commercial or product sponsors after launch to confirm the Lynk is being used, identify blockers to adoption, and capture feedback for future roadmap needs.
* Help create repeatable processes for Lynk intake, prioritization, credential coordination, testing, launch readiness, inventory updates, and business communication.


**Preferred Experience And Skills**
* 4\+ years in product analysis, business analysis, systems analysis, integrations, implementation delivery, product operations, or technology project coordination.
* 5–7 years preferred.
* Experience supporting APIs, third\-party integrations, customer implementations, technology delivery, platform products, SaaS solutions, or logistics systems preferred.
* Experience coordinating with external customers, vendors, carriers, platforms, or technology partners preferred.
* Strong project management skills, including issue tracking, dependency management, follow\-up, documentation, and cross\-functional coordination.
* Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear requirements and delivery\-ready work.
* Comfort supporting testing, UAT, defect resolution, and launch readiness.
* Strong communication skills and ability to explain technical capabilities in business terms.


**Employee Type**
 Permanent
   

  

 UPS is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first\-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install\-not\-transacted user cohorts

* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross\-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment

* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on\-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in\-depth interviews, ethnographic observation

title: Senior IBM i Administrator
description:
**ASSA ABLOY** 
 is a global leader in access solutions, dedicated to shaping the future of security and convenience. With a rich heritage spanning over 150 years, ASSA ABLOY has built a reputation for delivering innovative and reliable locking and access control solutions. Their diverse portfolio includes well\-known brands like Yale, HID Global, and Mul\-T\-Lock, offering a comprehensive range of products and services to meet the unique needs of customers worldwide. From residential and commercial buildings to critical infrastructure and healthcare facilities, ASSA ABLOY's cutting\-edge technologies ensure safety, security, and seamless user experiences. With a commitment to sustainability and customer satisfaction, ASSA ABLOY continues to drive advancements in access solutions for a safer and more connected world.
   

  

**Summary** 
 : We are seeking a highly experienced
 **Senior IBM i Administrator** 
 to manage and maintain our IBM i (AS/400, iSeries) systems. The ideal candidate will be proficient in day\-to\-day operations, monitoring, and performance tuning, with a strong secondary focus on
 **IBM i security hardening** 
 , compliance, and best practices.
   

  

 You will work as a key member of our IT infrastructure team to ensure system availability, reliability, and security in a mission\-critical environment.
   

  

**Summary Of Responsibilities**
**System Operations**
* Monitor and manage the health, performance, and availability of IBM i systems.
* Execute and maintain backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures.
* Perform IPLs, system saves, PTF installations, and license key updates.
* Schedule, monitor, and troubleshoot batch jobs and job queues.
* Perform daily system checks and log reviews to ensure optimal operation.
* Collaborate with application teams to troubleshoot issues and optimize system usage.


**Security \& Hardening**
* Conduct IBM i security audits and implement corrective actions to address vulnerabilities.
* Harden system security by configuring object\-level and user profile security, exit programs, authority collections, and audit journaling.
* Implement and maintain security policies in line with industry standards (e.g., NIST, CIS) and compliance frameworks (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, PCI).
* Manage and monitor security logs (QAUDJRN) and intrusion detection/prevention settings.
* Work with internal auditors or external consultants to ensure compliance with internal and external security requirements.
* Review and improve user access controls, password policies, and role\-based authority.


**Qualifications**
 To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
   

  

**EDUCATION:**
 Preferred undergraduate degree in computer science, information systems or related field and/or equivalent work experience.
   

  

**EXPERIENCE:**
 A Minimum of 5 years related experience in a business production environment.
   

  

**Required**
**TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE and/or ABILITIES**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with IBM i operations and administration.
* Strong working knowledge of IBM i command line and system tools (e.g., WRKACTJOB, WRKSYSSTS, WRKDSKSTS).
* Experience with IBM i security features: user profile management, object authority, exit points, and audit journal.
* Proficiency in backup and recovery techniques using BRMS or equivalent.
* Experience with security auditing tools such as PowerTech, HelpSystems, or native IBM i tools.
* Excellent problem\-solving, documentation, and communication skills.


**Preferred**
* Experience implementing IBM i security best practices and frameworks.
* Familiarity with RPG\-based application environments.
* Understanding of TCP/IP networking and communication protocols on IBM i.
* IBM i certification (e.g., IBM Certified System Administrator \- IBM i) is a plus.
* Experience with high availability (HA) technologies and logical partitioning (LPAR).


**Soft Skills**
* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with IBM i platform developments


**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
 Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.

 **full\-time, on\-site role**

 **multi\-functional creative role** 
 combining
 **creative writing, social media management, campaign ideation and client engagement** 
 .

 **think of ideas as well as help execute them** 
 .
* The role involves working closely with
 **designers, video editors, photographers, social media managers and business development teams** 
 .
* Occasional travel may be required for
 **shoots, events, client meetings and content production** 
 .
* If you are looking only for a purely writing\-focused role, this position may not be the right fit.



  





**ABOUT DIGENIE** 




  





**Digenie** 
 is a digital marketing and business solutions company with over a decade of collective experience, serving businesses across
 **India, the UK, the US and Canada** 
 .
 



 Our services include:
 


* Digital \& Social Media Marketing
* Creative \& Content
* Web \& App Development
* Staffing Solutions
* Translation Services
* Data Analytics
* Technology \& Business Solutions



  





 We work with brands across different industries and develop customized, research\-driven strategies and creative solutions.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




 We are looking for a
 **Creative Writer \& Social Media Executive** 
 who can combine
 **strong writing, creative thinking, social media knowledge and communication skills** 
 .
 



 You will help manage social media accounts, develop content and campaign ideas, write scripts and copy, coordinate with the creative team and participate in client discussions.
 



 The role also involves
 **supporting business development from a creative perspective** 
 by researching prospective clients, identifying content opportunities and contributing ideas to pitches.
 



 The ideal candidate should be able to take a brief and turn it into:
 



**Insight → Idea → Content → Campaign → Execution** 




  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**1\. Creative Writing \& Content** 



* Write
 **social media captions, scripts, hooks, headlines and promotional copy** 
 .
* Develop scripts for
 **Reels, Shorts and other short\-form videos** 
 .
* Create storytelling concepts for different brands.
* Develop strong
 **CTAs and opening hooks** 
 .
* Adapt writing style according to each brand's personality and audience.
* Research topics before developing content.
* Proofread and refine content before publishing.
* Maintain consistency in brand voice and communication.
* Develop ideas around relevant
 **trends, cultural moments, memes and current conversations** 
 .



  





**2\. Social Media Management** 



* Assist in managing social media accounts for multiple brands.
* Develop and maintain
 **monthly/weekly content calendars** 
 .
* Plan content across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.
* Coordinate with designers and editors to ensure content is executed on schedule.
* Review captions, creatives and videos before publishing.
* Schedule and publish content where required.
* Monitor audience responses, comments and messages where applicable.
* Track basic content performance and suggest improvements.
* Stay updated on platform trends and emerging content formats.



  





**3\. Creative Ideation** 



* Generate ideas for
 **posters, carousels, Reels, videos and social campaigns** 
 .
* Develop creative hooks and concepts for short\-form content.
* Suggest visual directions and references to designers.
* Suggest editing styles, transitions and visual treatments to video teams.
* Participate in creative brainstorming sessions.
* Turn simple or ordinary briefs into more engaging content concepts.
* Draw inspiration from
 **advertising, films, pop culture, memes, internet culture and current trends** 
 where appropriate.



  





**4\. Campaign Development** 



* Develop
 **campaign concepts, themes and communication directions** 
 .
* Create ideas for seasonal, promotional and topical campaigns.
* Develop content series and campaign narratives.
* Identify opportunities around festivals, cultural events and relevant trends.
* Help convert campaign concepts into actual social media content.
* Participate in campaign presentations and creative discussions.



  





**5\. Client Communication** 



* Participate in client calls and meetings when required.
* Understand client requirements, objectives and expectations.
* Convert client briefs into clear creative requirements.
* Present creative ideas and explain the thinking behind them.
* Communicate professionally with clients.
* Collect and understand feedback.
* Coordinate with internal teams to implement revisions.
* Develop an understanding of each client's
 **brand, audience, competitors and communication style** 
 .



  





**6\. Business Development Support** 




 You will also contribute to
 **client acquisition from a creative and research perspective** 
 .
 



 This may include:
 


* Researching potential clients and their brands.
* Reviewing their websites and social media presence.
* Identifying gaps in their current content and communication.
* Developing
 **sample creative ideas or content opportunities** 
 for prospective clients.
* Providing creative insights to the Business Development team.
* Supporting presentations and pitches with content and campaign ideas.
* Participating in pitches when creative input is required.



  





**This is not a conventional sales role.** 
 However, you should be comfortable contributing to client acquisition through
 **research, creative thinking, communication and understanding of digital marketing** 
 .
 



  





**SHOOTS \& TRAVEL** 




 This is an
 **on\-site role based in Egmore, Chennai** 
 .
 



  





 Occasional travel may be required for:
 


* Client meetings
* Photoshoots and video shoots
* Events and activations
* On\-location content creation
* Campaign execution
* Other content\-related activities



  





 You should therefore be comfortable with
 **local travel within Chennai and occasional travel outside Chennai** 
 when required.
 



  





**REQUIRED SKILLS** 



* Strong
 **English writing and communication skills** 
 .
* Excellent grammar and attention to detail.
* Strong creative thinking and ideation ability.
* Good understanding of social media platforms.
* Strong understanding of
 **Instagram and short\-form content** 
 .
* Ability to write engaging hooks, captions and scripts.
* Good storytelling ability.
* Ability to understand and adapt to different brand voices.
* Strong research skills.
* Good understanding of current trends and internet culture.
* Ability to work effectively with designers and video editors.
* Good client communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and deadlines.

 .

* Experience managing multiple brand accounts.
* Experience writing

 .

* Understands
 **memes, trends, pop culture and internet culture** 
 .

 **professionally and creatively** 
 .

* Can balance
 **creativity, brand requirements, client expectations and deadlines** 
 .

 **English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Advertising, Marketing, Media or a related field**

* Experience writing scripts for Reels or short\-form videos is an advantage.
* Freshers with
 **exceptionally strong writing, communication and creative skills**

**CORE SKILLS** 




**Creative Writing • Copywriting • Storytelling • Social Media Management • Content Strategy • Campaign Ideation • Script Writing • Trend Research • Brand Communication • Creative Direction • Client Communication • Presentation • Basic Design • Basic Video Understanding**

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a Powder Coating Booth Operator, you will manage end\-to\-end powder coating booth operations while ensuring that you achieve safety, quality, productivity, and continuous improvement standards.
   

  

 You will report to the Production supervisor and work onsite at our Kancheepuram facility.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Take complete ownership of Powder Coating Booth operations, including workplace organisation through 5S implementation and housekeeping activities.
* Maintain electrostatic powder coating equipment, pretreatment systems, ovens, jigs, hooks, templates, and associated fixtures.
* Manage powder coating process parameters including powder mixing ratios, recycled powder usage, coating quality, and product output to meet quality and delivery targets.
* Perform quality inspections and testing including DFT (Dry Film Thickness), Impact Test, Scratch Test, Bend Test, and Gloss Level Test while maintaining production and maintenance records.
* Ensure compliance with safety procedures, PPE requirements, chemical handling regulations, continuous improvement programmes, and training of co\-associates to support operational excellence.

**Job Summary**
 Serve as a specialist in health care claims processing for Medicare and Medicaid claims and commercial claims within a remote work from home environment focusing on accurate adjudication compliance with health care product guidelines and timely resolution of member and provider claim inquiries during night shift operations while communicating effectively in English to support business quality and service goals.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Review health care product claim submissions for Medicare and Medicaid and commercial programs to ensure accurate data capture and alignment with policy and benefit rules minimizing errors and rework to support operational efficiency and member satisfaction.
* Analyze claim details and supporting documentation to validate eligibility coverage and pricing logic and to identify discrepancies or potential issues that could negatively impact members providers or company financial outcomes.
* Process assigned claims queues within established service levels by applying adjudication rules and regulatory requirements ensuring that each claim outcome supports organizational quality standards and customer commitments.
* Collaborate with internal operations and configuration teams through clear written and spoken English communication to resolve claim processing issues share insights on recurring defects and contribute to continuous improvement of health care product workflows.
* Investigate claim escalations from customer service or provider relations by reviewing transaction history and system notes then provide detailed resolutions that address root causes and enhance trust in company claims handling.
* Maintain up to date knowledge of Medicare and Medicaid regulations and commercial plan guidelines related to claims handling so that daily decisions remain compliant and reduce risk of audit findings or penalties.
* Utilize claims administration systems and reporting tools to track claim status identify aging or backlog trends and propose practical actions that help the team meet productivity and accuracy targets.
* Document all claim actions in the system with clear concise and complete notes to ensure transparency for downstream teams and support accurate reporting to business stakeholders.
* Coordinate with quality review teams when claim samples are audited by responding to findings explaining processing decisions and integrating feedback into future claim handling practices.
* Support night shift operations by managing workload independently escalating only complex or policy sensitive scenarios and ensuring continuous coverage that upholds service commitments in a work from home model.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing by updating procedure references and claim processing tips based on new health care product features or regulatory changes helping colleagues deliver consistent service and outcomes.
* Identify patterns in claim denials or adjustments across Medicare and Medicaid and commercial segments to recommend improvements in messaging configuration or provider education that reduce avoidable rework and member dissatisfaction.
* Engage in periodic training and calibration sessions to refine adjudication skills strengthen regulatory understanding and align individual performance with company objectives and societal impact through fair and accurate claims decisions.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate practical experience working with health care products and claim administration platforms for at least one year and not more than three years with a proven record of accurate and timely claims processing within a structured environment.
* Show strong domain expertise in Medicare and Medicaid claims by confidently interpreting benefit rules cost sharing structures and regulatory requirements involved in claim adjudication and resolution activities.
* Apply solid knowledge of commercial claims operations including plan variations network considerations and pricing approaches so that decisions consistently reflect product intent and contractual obligations.
* Communicate fluently in English in both written and spoken forms to collaborate effectively with peers supervisors and cross functional teams and to craft clear claim notes and responses that support transparency and service quality.
* Thrive in a work from home night shift setting by maintaining focus self discipline and reliable connectivity while meeting defined productivity quality and attendance expectations without direct physical supervision.
* Adapt quickly to changes in health care product features claim rules and system enhancements by engaging in ongoing learning and applying updated guidance accurately to daily claim processing tasks.


**Certifications Required**
 Preferred certification in health care claims or medical billing such as Certified Professional Coder or equivalent industry credential.

Working seamlessly with Bechtel’s global business units, project sites, customers, and suppliers, our teams have delivered more than 125 projects since 1994\. With offices in Gurgaon, Vadodara, and Chennai there are exciting career opportunities for candidates who are passionate about delivering projects that make a lasting, meaningful difference for people and communities around the world.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 In this role, you will represent Bechtel as the supplier's project quality point of contact. You will perform quality surveillance and hands on inspections to verify that supplier equipment, material, documentation, and personnel activities conform to the requirements of procurement documents. You will work with supplier representatives to ensure requirements are understood and implemented.
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
* On a small sized project, represents Bechtel as the supplier’s prime contact with respect to supplier quality and performs quality surveillance activities defined by the assignment scope to verify that supplier furnished equipment and material conforms to the technical and quality requirements of the procurement documents
* Reviews the procurement document requirements with supplier representatives to ensure they are understood and implemented
* Monitors supplier personnel activities including witnessing of operations, inspections, examinations, or tests to verify procurement document requirements have been met
* Performs hands on inspections to verify by re\-examination the efficacy of supplier inspection efforts and to provide assurance of the conformance of equipment or materials to procurement document requirements
* Reviews supplier generated quality verification documentation to verify conformance to procurement document requirements
* Rejects material found nonconforming and collaborates with the supplier and project supplier quality personnel to obtain a course of supplier action which facilitates satisfactory disposition of disclosed non\-conformances
* Releases conforming material for shipment and notifies other Bechtel functional organizations to assist in coordination of their activities
* Evaluates supplier’s conformance to specified quality criteria on a specific assignment or group of assignments to provide input to recommendations for placement of future orders
* Conducts surveys or audits or surveys of suppliers, when assigned
* Participates as an audit team member or technical resource for nuclear material and/or quality program audits


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* Requires bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) and 5\-8 years of relevant experience or 9\-12 years of relevant work experience


**Required Knowledge And Skills**
* Reviews material requisitions including technical specifications with respect to quality requirements and participates with Engineering in determining the levels of surveillance required and establishing witness and hold points.
* Assists in the development of the final bid list and the selection of a recommended bidder
* Assists with the establishment of Quality Surveillance levels required for each purchase
* Participates in pre\-award and post\-award meetings/conferences with suppliers to review Area Supplier Quality’s right of access, release for shipment authority, and notification on witness and hold points during quality surveillance activities
* Prepares quality surveillance and capability survey assignments for execution by the assigned Area Supplier Quality Specialists
* Investigate quality issues reported to the Supplier Quality Manager on equipment/materials where quality surveillance has been performed. Available documents such as UOS\&Ds, Field Change Notices, back charge notices, NCR \& Deviation Report registers, etc. should be utilized during the investigation process
* Review, edit, accept and distribute reports in accordance with this Manual and Project Procedures. Ensure survey and audit reports are approved and then posted into GSIS
* Regularly check anomaly code information and assignment information which has been siphoned from Quality Surveillance Reports into SQEAS is accurate and make any necessary corrections
* Provide project direction to Supplier Quality Representatives that carry assignments for Project

title: What being a Care Buddy means at Prayojana?
description:
The Care Buddy will be the first point of contact and the face of the Prayojana. More importantly, they will participate in supporting their assigned members with the same level of empathy and warmth that the member's own children would have
   

  

**The Care Buddy’s Primary Role Will Be To**
* Check on the members assigned to her/him on their day to day well being
* Help out with errands – like bank\-related work, basic groceries or vegetable procurement
* Schedule appointments for doctor visits \& accompany them for such
* Schedule periodic lab visits as required
* Help members handle any technology\-related issues, like setting up Whatsapp, fixing internet issues, using social media (Facebook, Instagram), etc.
* Visit the member at least once in a week or as frequently as required, to check their needs \& help them accordingly
* Educate them on the process of emergency management, how to call, what to do etc.
* In case of an emergency
* report to the hospital \& co\-ordinate or facilitate the treatment
* keep all stakeholders informed on the status
* Update medical records in Prayojana Health App from time to time
* Monitor medicine inventory \& help in ordering refills
* Be a friend to the member, accompany them for walks once in a week
* Accompany them to social events, concerts as per requests
* Organize tickets for events like music concerts, movie, drama if needed
* Arrange \& co\-ordinate transportation needs for the members for them to go to such events/family functions


 A Care Buddy will be assigned a maximum of 10 members to assist at most simultaneously
   

  

**Who can be a Care Buddy?**
 Our Requirements
   

  

* Should be a person with a high level of integrity \& trustworthiness
* Should be independent \& willing to be available to take emergency calls 24x7
* Should demonstrate a high level of empathy \& patience, willing to listen, be polite, softspoken, punctual \& stick to commitments
* Be willing to go the extra mile to keep seniors happy, comfortable and without worry about how to manage their day\-to\-day life
* Should have experience using web and mobile\-based applications with basic computer and internet knowledge
* Should have a personal two\-wheeler (bike/scooter)


**Nice to have**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Social Work would be a big plus

title: University Guidance and Career Counselling
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
 



  





 University Guidance \& Career Counsellor – IBDP \& Cambridge A Level
 



 Designation: University Guidance \& Career Counsellor
 



 Reporting To: Head of School / Director
 



 Location: Chennai
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We are seeking an experienced University Guidance \& Career Counsellor to lead undergraduate university counselling for students pursuing IBDP and Cambridge A Level. The role will manage the complete student journey from career exploration and profile building to university selection, application, admission and enrolment, across India and international destinations.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Provide individualised university and career counselling from Grade 6 onwards.
* Develop student profiles, career pathways and strategic university application plans.
* Guide students on university selection, including reach, match and safety choices.
* Manage end\-to\-end applications through UCAS, Common App, BridgeU and other international/Indian portals.
* Review and guide students on personal statements, essays, resumes, portfolios, interviews and entrance assessments.
* Advise on SAT, ACT, IELTS, TOEFL, scholarships, financial aid and university\-specific requirements.
* Maintain application timelines, documentation, predicted grades and recommendation requirements.
* Conduct student/parent counselling sessions, university admission workshops and career guidance programmes.
* Build relationships with universities and coordinate university visits, fairs and admission interactions.
* Maintain accurate application records and report on offers, admissions, scholarships and placement outcomes.



  





 Education \& Experience
 


* Master's degree in Education, Counselling, Psychology, Career Guidance or a related field.
* 5–6 years of experience in university counselling, college admissions or student placement.
* Mandatory experience with IBDP and/or Cambridge A Level, preferably in an international school.
* Proven success in undergraduate placements to top global universities, including Ivy League, Oxbridge, Russell Group and other highly selective institutions.
* Strong knowledge of Indian and international university admissions and application processes.
* Experience with UCAS, Common App and BridgeU is essential.
* Strong university network and demonstrated ability to manage multiple applications and deadlines.



  





 Preferred Institutional Background
 



 Preference will be given to candidates with relevant experience in reputed university counselling/college admissions organisations such as:
 



 Crimson Education India \| Athena Education \| Univariety \| Mindways \| Bon Avenir
 



 Candidates from comparable organisations with strong experience in student profile building, university strategy, application management and international admissions may also be considered.
 



  





 Key Competencies
 


* Excellent counselling, mentoring and communication skills.
* Strong knowledge of global higher education and admissions trends.
* Strategic thinking with strong attention to detail.
* Excellent stakeholder management and parent engagement skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple students, applications and deadlines.
* High professional integrity and confidentiality.



  





 Key Performance Indicators
 


* Successful university placements and quality of offers.
* Admissions to highly selective/top\-ranked universities.
* Student and parent satisfaction.
* Timely and accurate application completion.
* Scholarships/financial aid secured.
* Effective university engagement and career guidance programmes.



  





 The ideal candidate will combine strong counselling expertise with proven international admissions experience and a demonstrated track record of achieving exceptional university outcomes for students.

title: Environment Analyst
description:
Join us as an Environment Analyst
   

  

* In this key role, you’ll support a set of environments used by a platform’s applications and assist as a point of contact for environment related activities
* We’ll look to you to assist Environment Managers in preparing a rolling environmental strategy which considers risks in relation to stability and resilience
* You’ll be joining a collaborative and supportive team, and have the opportunity to work with a range of stakeholders across the bank
* We're offering this role at senior analyst level


 What you'll do
   

  

 We’re looking for an Environment Analyst to enable the successful implementation of platform change and deliver customer value by assisting Environment Managers to deliver complex and critical environment related activities. You’ll help create stories and features for the domain backlog to enable a continual progression of changes and look for ways to improve efficiency, resilience, reliability, quality and manual inconsistency by increasing the use of automation and virtualisation.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Also Include**
* Supporting Environment Managers in managing a set of non\-production environments and maintaining non\-production environment dashboards
* Understanding and maintaining a focus on customer value and providing a positive customer experience
* Working with Environment Managers to understand the upcoming flow of work and the customer vision in order to contribute to a fast response to environment related needs
* Understanding and communicating the environment status, health checks and status reports for the platform’s environments
* Working with a range of stakeholders across the bank and third\-party suppliers to make sure that platform environments are optimised


 The skills you'll need
   

  

 We’re looking for a capable communicator, with knowledge of scaled Agile and Prince 2 tools and methodologies spanning value stream, portfolio, platform and feature team levels. You’ll also need technical knowledge, including platform, technology, products and domains and experience in multiple languages or technical domains.
   

  

**We’ll Also Expect**
* Experience in supporting and maintaining non\-production environments and related dashboards
* Experience in monitoring environment health, performance, and availability, with the ability to proactively identify and resolve issues
* Expertise in delivering environment changes through collaboration with technology teams and stakeholders
* Expertise in process automation to improve efficiency and reliability
* Good collaboration and stakeholder management skills

description:

 On\-Premise Data Centre \& DR
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced
 **Airflow Architect** 
 to design, build and own an enterprise\-grade Apache Airflow platform across on\-premise Data Centre and DR environments.
 



 The primary focus is
 **infrastructure and operations automation** 
 , with data pipelines as a secondary workload.
 



 You will be the technical authority for Airflow, owning architecture, HA/DR, security, performance, upgrades and the engineering team operating the platform.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Architecture \& Platform** 



* Design and implement highly available Airflow on\-premise.
* Architect multi\-scheduler, redundant web/API, Celery worker and RabbitMQ infrastructure.
* Design and test DC/DR architecture, including RTO/RPO, failover and failback.
* Establish Dev/UAT/Pre\-Prod/Prod/DR environments.
* Own Terraform/Ansible\-based Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD for DAG deployment.
* Integrate with LDAP/AD/SSO, Vault/CyberArk, PKI and enterprise storage/logging.



  





**Infrastructure Automation** 




 Build reusable Airflow workflows for:
 


* OS/middleware patching and rollback
* VM/server/container provisioning
* Backup and restore validation
* Certificate and credential rotation
* Health checks and auto\-remediation
* Compliance and configuration\-drift checks
* DR drills and evidence collection
* Access provisioning and recertification
* Cross\-system runbook automation



 Develop custom
 **Operators, Hooks, Sensors and Plugins** 
 integrating with Ansible, SSH/WinRM, REST APIs, network, storage, backup and monitoring systems.
 



 Implement safe\-automation controls such as approval gates, dry\-runs, blast\-radius limits, maintenance windows and audit trails.
 



  





**MySQL Metadata Layer** 



* Architect and operate
 **MySQL 8\.x** 
 for Airflow.
* Experience with InnoDB, GTID, replication, InnoDB Cluster/Group Replication and PITR.
* Tune connection pools, InnoDB, queries and Airflow metadata tables.
* Design backup, restore, failover and schema\-migration strategies.



  





**Performance \& Reliability** 



* Own Airflow capacity planning and performance tuning.
* Optimise schedulers, workers, concurrency, pools and queue performance.
* Implement monitoring using
 **Prometheus/StatsD, Grafana, ELK/Loki** 
 .
* Monitor scheduler health, task latency, queue depth, DB connections and replication lag.



  





**Security \& Operations** 



* Own Airflow, Python dependency, OS, MySQL and RabbitMQ vulnerability management.
* Handle CVE assessment, Nessus/SonarQube findings and VAPT remediation.
* Implement TLS, RBAC, Vault\-based secrets, network segmentation and privileged\-access controls.
* Maintain SOPs, HLD/LLD, runbooks and operational documentation.



  





**Leadership** 



* Lead a team of \~8 platform/support engineers.
* Conduct architecture and code reviews.
* Own production SLAs, incidents, changes and technical roadmap.
* Represent the platform in architecture and change\-management forums.



  





**Must Have Skills** 



* **8–10 years** 
 Infrastructure / Platform / DevOps / SRE experience.
* **5\+ years production Apache Airflow** 
 experience.
* Proven experience building and operating
 **Airflow on\-premise** 
 , including HA and DR.
* Strong
 **MySQL 8\.x** 
 administration and performance tuning.
* Production experience with
 **Celery Executor and RabbitMQ** 
 .
* Strong
 **Python** 
 , Linux and shell scripting.
* Hands\-on
 **Ansible/AWX and Terraform** 
 .
* CI/CD experience with Jenkins, GitLab CI or equivalent.
* Experience with Grafana, Prometheus/StatsD and ELK/Loki.
* Strong understanding of enterprise security, vulnerability management and ITIL processes.
* Proven technical leadership and production SLA ownership.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Control\-M / Autosys / Tidal / Rundeck migration experience.
* ServiceNow / CMDB integration.
* VMware, Veeam, NetBackup or Commvault.
* Vault, Keycloak, LDAP/Kerberos.

* BFSI, Telecom or Healthcare experience.

title: Trainer - Transcription Review
description:
Role: Trainer — Transcription Review
   

 Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu · Full\-time
   

 Reports to: Operations Manager
   

  

 About the role:
   

 We run an English\-language transcription\-review operation: reviewers listen to audio and correct machine\-generated text into clean, accurate, client ready transcripts — working on platforms and to quality standards similar to TranscribeMe.
   

 As Trainer, you own how quickly and how well new joiners reach production standard, and you build our team of Reviewers who correct and finalize transcripts to a client\-ready bar. You will design and run onboarding, coach on clean\-verbatim style and English grammar, calibrate the team to a single standard, and grow reviewer capability as we scale from a small pilot team to \~90 seats
   

  

 What you'll do:
   

 • Onboard new reviewers — deliver structured training on platform/tool navigation, clean\-verbatim style, speech tags (inaudible, crosstalk, etc.), speaker labelling, timestamps, and researching names and terms.
   

 • Own the curriculum — build and maintain the training material, house style guide, and a certification/assessment path; keep them current as client style guides change (US vs. Commonwealth English, file\-specific rules).
   

 • Coach English fundamentals — grammar, punctuation, spelling, and formatting to one consistent standard; run targeted refreshers on recurring error patterns.
   

 • Develop Senior / Lead Reviewers — identify strong performers and grow them into senior reviewer roles who can guide others and hold the quality bar as the team expands.
   

 • Run calibration — hold regular sessions so all reviewers correct the same file the same way; track and close inconsistencies between reviewers.
   

 • Own ramp\-quality metrics — time\-to\-productivity, accuracy / rejection rate, critical\-error rate, and rework rate; report progress against the hiring ramp.
   

 • Pick up new domains fast — absorb new subject areas and client accounts and turn them into training material quickly (e.g., US legal transcription conventions where required).
   

  

 Must have:
   

 • Excellent command of English — near\-native grammar, punctuation, and spelling (US and Commonwealth), with strong reading comprehension and an ear for meaning.
   

 • Transcription, proofreading, or review background, ideally including clean\-verbatim work.
   

 • Fast domain learner — able to absorb a new subject or style guide and teach it clearly within days, not weeks.
   

 • A coaching instinct — patient, structured, and able to give feedback that actually changes behaviour.
   

 • Detail\-obsessed — comfortable holding a quality standard and working to measurable accuracy targets.
   

  

 Nice to have:
   

 • Exposure to US legal / court transcription conventions — verbatim vs. non\-verbatim, speaker labels, bracketed notation (\[phonetic], \[indiscernible]), and numeral/formatting rules.
   

 • Hands\-on experience with TranscribeMe (or Rev, GoTranscript, Verbit, etc.) as a transcriber or reviewer.
   

 • Experience handling varied English accents (US, UK, Australian, Indian) and difficult audio.
   

 • Prior experience standing up training for a new or scaling team.
   

  

 Success in the first 90 days:
   

 • New reviewers reliably reach production accuracy within the defined ramp window.
   

 • A documented house style guide, training deck, and certification test are live.
   

 • At least one internal Senior Reviewer cohort is trained and holding the standard independently.

title: Lead/ Sr. Analyst – Business Research/ Market Intelligence/ Competitive Intelligence
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 Position Title: Lead/ Sr. Analyst – Business Research/ Market Intelligence
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad/ Chennai
   

  

**Job Description**
 Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) at Chennai/ Hyderabad to drive analytics \& technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.
   

  

 As a Lead Analyst, you will act as a dedicated SME to Roche’s global business partners. You will transcend traditional data collection by integrating Clinical and Commercial Competitive Intelligence (CI), Market intelligence with advanced GenAI\-driven analytics. Your goal is to provide high\-level strategic
   

  

 foresight using established business frameworks to influence Roche’s global product pipeline and commercial launch strategies.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

* Integrated Strategic Competitive/ Market Intelligence: Lead the end\-to\-end monitoring of the competitive landscape, bifurcating insights into Clinical CI (R\&D pipeline, trial design shifts, MoA breakthroughs) and Commercial CI (pricing, market access, field force shifts, and launch trajectories)
* Strategic Framework Application: Synthesize complex market signals into actionable strategies using structured frameworks such as SWOT, PESTLE, Porter’s Five Forces, and Patient Journey Mapping to identify unmet needs and white\-space opportunities
* GenAI \& Innovation: Architect and implement GenAI\-powered workflows (e.g., LLMs for rapid secondary research synthesis, automated earnings call sentiment analysis, or GPT\-based clinical trial summarization) to increase the velocity and depth of strategic recommendations
* High\-Stakes Conference Coverage (ASCO, ESMO, AACR, JP Morgan, Jefferies, etc.): Provide pre\-conference/ post\-conference impact assessment analysis of competitor data readouts on Roche’s portfolio
* Strategic Advisory: Transform market insights from public \& proprietary data sources (e.g. CT.gov, Clarivate, AlphaSense, EvaluatePharma) into "Executive Stories" that provide clear "So What?" and "Now What?" recommendations to partners \& senior leadership
* Predictive Intelligence: Flag "Trigger Events" (e.g., Breakthrough Designations, FDA/ regulatory signals, M\&A activity) and perform Scenario Planning to assess potential implications for Roche brands


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Experience: 5–8 years of experience in Strategic Business Research/ Market Research/ CI within Pharma/Life Sciences
* Methodology: Expert\-level proficiency in applying Business Research Frameworks (SWOT, PESTLE) to the pharmaceutical lifecycle—from Phase I to Loss of Exclusivity (LoE)
* Tech\-Savviness: Proven experience or a strong vision for using GenAI tools to automate data extraction and enhance strategic consulting
* Commercial Acumen: Deep understanding of the Drug Development Process, including clinical trial endpoints, regulatory pathways (FDA/EMA), and commercial launch excellence
* Communication: Ability to influence global stakeholders through structured communication and data visualization
* Self\-Driven Ownership: A proactive "self\-starter" who manages complex projects with minimal guidance in a fast\-paced global environment
* Innovative Problem\-Solver: Possesses an agile, GenAI\-forward mindset to reinvent research workflows and tackle intricate life science challenges
* Strategic Influencer: Passionate about the "why" behind the data, using structured narratives to move stakeholders from insights to action


 Education
   

  

* UG: B. Tech/B.E./B. Pharm
* PG (Preferred): MBA or Masters in Life Sciences/Biotechnology


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

 With a global team of 5600\+ IT professionals, DHL IT Services connects people and keeps the global economy running by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions.  At IT Services, we are passionate about JAVA, C\# and mobile technologies. Our Self Service Solutions team is continuously expanding. We are looking for a Senior Test Automation Engineer. In our diverse environment you can always grow depending on your qualification level.
   

  

 We are working in an agile way. This means that our teams are completely product oriented, have end to end responsibility both for the product in development and in production. The same people not only take care of the application, but also of the business side of the product. The everyday work is typically organized using agile frameworks. This means the implementation of daily scrum, reviews, and retrospectives.
   

  

**Grow together** 
 .
   

  

 Our mission in Self Service Solutions is “We strive for a Business Partner and Product centric organization, that lives E2E responsibility by maximizing team empowerment”. In our team we are building a team culture with proactive E2E mindset enabling us as IT Services Self Service Solutions to be a competitive advantage for the group. We are responsible for round about 14\.000 lockers from DHL all over Germany. We currently have 3 different types of lockers in use. The Packstation Classic with its focus on Java, the Lean Packstation with its focus on Java, iOS and Android and the Poststation. The Poststation is a combination of a Classic and a Retail Store with a focus on C\# and React. Our test automation development is based on gherkin, cucumber, java and playwright. Like our company, our team is quite global. We have technical teams located in Chennai, Prague, Darmstadt, Berlin and Bonn. To help us collaborate better, we are using tools like Teams, Jira, Confluence or Mural. You will find a nice mix of motivated people, typically geeks who are passionate about technology and who are reading about IT, even after work. But most importantly, we are a team where everyone supports each other even in tough times and where every single member tries to make things better every day
   

  

**Ready to embark on the journey? Here’s what we are looking for** 
 :
   

  

 As a 3rd Level Support Engineer, you will be responsible for the technical operation, incident resolution, and continuous improvement of the Broker and LPS backend services. Working in an international environment, you will collaborate closely with global stakeholders, ensuring stability, performance, and reliability of critical applications. This role requires strong analytical capabilities, a high sense of ownership, and a proactive mindset in identifying and resolving technical and procedural issues.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

  

* Handle Incidents and Service Requests in 3rd Level Support for the Broker and LPS applications, ensuring timely and accurate resolution.
* Daily Monitoring the Broker and LPS backend services, applications and interfaces to ensure stability, availability, and proper system behavior.
* Perform proactive and reactive Problem Management, including detailed root cause analysis and preparation of both workaround and permanent solution proposals.
* Support the Service Owner in the preparation and execution of Change Requests according to ITIL processes.
* Participate in operational acceptance tests and rollout activities, ensuring production readiness.
* Execute smoke tests on various environments to validate service functionality and early identify potential issues before deployment and “Going\-Live”.
* Create ad\-hoc database reports based on Service Requests and operational needs.
* Optimize the performance of database queries and existing SQL reports, identifying opportunities for improving overall system efficiency.
* Develop and propose improvement measures for processes, system components (especially the existing PACKSTATION Broker applications and their interfaces), and operational workflows.


 Personal Requirements
   

  

  

* Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to convey technical information clearly and professionally to diverse stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, enabling effective handling of complex incidents and identification of long\-term corrective measures.
* Self\-driven and well\-organized working style, with the ability to manage priorities independently while ensuring high\-quality delivery.
* Proven ability to work effectively in international, virtual, and cross\-functional teams, demonstrating cultural awareness and collaborative mindset.
* High customer orientation, ensuring responsiveness, ownership, and reliable support throughout the entire incident lifecycle.
* Resilience and adaptability when dealing with high\-pressure situations, critical incidents, and changing business priorities.
* Detail\-oriented approach to documentation, ensuring accuracy and clarity in technical guidelines, knowledge articles, and operational procedures.
* Continuous improvement mindset, with a willingness to learn new technologies, follow standards, and contribute to process optimization.


 Professional Requirements
   

  

  

* Excellent SQL and PL/SQL skills, with hands\-on experience in Oracle environments and in the administration and optimization of complex database structures.
* Very strong Java development skills, ideally with experience in maintaining and enhancing enterprise\-grade applications.
* Advanced Linux expertise, including system administration, troubleshooting, and performance tuning in production environments.
* Strong scripting capabilities (e.g., shell scripting, Python, etc.) to support automation, monitoring, and operational workflows.
* In\-depth knowledge of the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), including log analysis, dashboard design, and performance optimization.
* Excellent knowledge of Global ServiceNow (Service Management Tool), particularly across incident, problem, change, and request management processes.
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification or equivalent understanding of IT Service Management best practices.
* Strong expertise in Oracle WebLogic, including configuration, deployment, performance tuning, and operational troubleshooting of middleware environments.
* Very good knowledge of Quarkus, including development, deployment, and optimization of cloud\-native or microservice\-based Java applications.

* 
+ Time Zone Alignment: Work night shifts in India (from Chennai office) to align with US business hours (EST, CST, MST, or PST).
+ IVR Navigation: Navigate complex Interactive Voice Response (IVR) systems of various utility companies to reach the correct B2B or customer service department.

*

+ Handle escalations and ensure timely resolution of customer and operational issues.

description:

* Solid continuous improvement mindset with experience leading change and supporting adoption

 You’ll have the opportunity to help improve Vestas’s standing in a key market for the company with promising perspectives of growth. Join Vestas and you’ll cultivate your career in an inspiring environment at the premier wind turbine producer, which has an ongoing dedication to sustainability. We value individual initiative, a readiness to accept responsibility, and the right balance of creativity and quality in every solution. At Vestas your achievement is our achievement.

title: Patent & Trademark Docketing Executive - Chennai
description:
Company Description:
 



 Altacit Global is an ISO 9001 certified and CRISIL Rated Law Firm with a strong presence across Bangalore, Chennai, Cochin, Coimbatore, and Hyderabad. The firm specializes in Corporate and Intellectual Property Law. Recognized by globally acclaimed legal guides such as Legal 500, Chambers and Partners, and Asia IP, Altacit Global is ranked among the top law firms in India. The firm is committed to delivering high\-quality legal services to meet diverse client needs.
 



 Role Description:
 



 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for a Patent \& Trademark Docketing Executive based in Chennai. The role involves managing all aspects of patent docketing, including filing and tracking patent applications, managing timelines for patent preparation and prosecution, and coordinating patent law compliance. The executive will also support patentability assessments and liaise with intellectual property attorneys to ensure accurate documentation and filings.
 



 Trademark Management:
 



 1\. Docketing and maintenance of records of trademark, copyright and design applications, status updation,prosecution, renewals, restoration and deadline tracking.
 



 2\. Monitoring of Journal Publications and reporting to associates.
 



 3\. Document handling and processing.
 



 4\. TMR Correspondence tracking and saving.
 



 5\. Client tracking and lead docketing.
 



 6\. Responsible for working and assisting associates.
 



 7\. Convey and draft instructions to foreign counsel related to trademark matters. Coordinates with different in\-house departments and supervise outside counsel to assure deadlines are met.
 



 8\. Performs searches of the Trademarks Journals and Trademarks Registries online database.
 



 9\. Support attorneys to prepare documents pertinent to oppositions, cancellations or litigations.
 



 10\. Develop and execute trademark portfolio reports.
 



 11\. The candidate prepares Trademark, Copyrights and designs applications for filing at the Registry.
 



 12\. Conduct through searches in trademark databases to identify potential oppositions to trademark applications. (Opposition Watch). Analyse search results and prepare detailed reports summarising findings.
 



 Patent Management:
 


1. Patent Management:Handle cost queries and coordinate with accounts for billing and invoicing.
2. File new patent applications via the IPO e\-filing and PCT modules.
3. Prepare and file all statutory forms.
4. Manage the Request for Examination (RFE) portfolio and amendment filings.
5. Prepare and file requests for addition/deletion of inventors, change of ownership (Form 6\), or withdrawal.
6. Follow up with clients and IPO regarding publication corrections, LPDs, recordal documents, and recordal status.
7. Track and ensure all IPO and PCT deadlines are met within due dates.
8. Handle NBA requests and ensure compliance with biodiversity regulations.
9. Maintain detailed records of filings, correspondence, and official communications.
10. Administrative \& Docketing Duties:Manage data entry and updates in the Docket Management System.
11. Digitize physical documents and organize electronic files systematically.
12. Generate periodic docketing reports and client\-specific status updates.
13. Coordinate with internal teams and clients to ensure seamless document flow.



  




* **Skills \& Qualifications:** 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in any discipline (Computer Science, or Data Management preferred).
* Minimum 2 years of experience in patent/trademark docketing or IP paralegal work.
* Strong computer proficiency — capable of handling data management systems, MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), and IP management/docketing software.
* Excellent organizational skills with keen attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines.
* Understanding of IPO, PCT, and trademark filing workflows.

title: Landside Surcharge Specialist
description:
At Maersk, we are a global leader in integrated logistics, pioneering the industry for over a century. Our commitment to innovation and transformation continuously redefines the boundaries of what’s possible—setting new benchmarks for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.
   

  

 We believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning, and strive to ensure our people reflect the customers we proudly serve. With a workforce of over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Process and maintain landside surcharges related to shipments and modes of transport (MOT), including truck, rail, and all SD movements.
* Accurate and timely execution of surcharge filings in AFLS in compliance with FMC and other government regulations.
* Identify discrepancies in surcharge filings or application and raise correction requests.
* Support timely filings by ensuring all applicable surcharges are captured correctly.
* Maintain proper documentation and audit trail for all surcharge\-related entries.
* Respond to queries related to landside surcharges and provide resolution support.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, tariff rules, and SOP guidelines.
* Assist in reducing duplicate entries or incorrect surcharge applications.
* Provide ad\-hoc support for operational requirements and generate reports as needed to support analysis, tracking, and decision\-making.
* Drive joint initiatives between GSC and Revenue management (ROM/CPM/ROP/IPM) which should help to achieve organization goals and to build a good rapport.
* Understand Customer’s requirement and focus on customer/revenue outcome.
* High attention to quality \- 100% is mandatory.
* Identify and prioritize tasks effectively.
* Timely reporting to Process Manager on day\-to\-day team performance and issues
* Flexible to do rotational shifts and weekends.


**Shift** 
 \- 12 PM\-9 PM (Can be rotational basis business needs)
   

  

**Required Qualification, Experience \& Skills**
* Graduate in any discipline
* Good in communication, process improvement, analytics \& convincing skills
* Minimum experience of 3 years in this portfolio
* Ability to work under pressure \- with high sense of urgency.
* Detail oriented \- ability to perform processes as per pre\-defined design.
* Good presentation and Microsoft excel skills.
* Should be able to analyse / foresee challenges.
* General awareness of the practical side of Commercial processes in shipping industry
* Expert in understanding short term \& Long\-term business.

* Understanding of price calculations, surcharge applications, additional costs \& booking requirements
* Should be able to explain clearly to all stakeholders on exceptions \& also if a different approach needs to be taken for route, pricings, etc.
* Proficient in accessing AFLS modules since most of the pricing related activities happens in AFLS application.
* Understand the SPOT business/logics and contract products to handle the business more efficiently.
* Knowledge of PMA \& ML.com is an advantage.
* Knowledge in Upstream and Downstream processes is preferable to collaborate things in a better way
* Should be prolific in error resolution and ability to suggest better solutions.
* Exposure of data analytics tools like SAPBI, Dataiku, Databricks, etc. is preferable.
* Should have proven experience in successfully executing Global transitions, ensuring effective Governance and seamless execution of the project.
* Adherence to timelines proposed or agreed with stakeholders.
* Partner with neighbouring processes (Upstream \& Downstream)/stakeholders and obtain buy\-in for complex and strategic initiatives.
* Willing to learn and adapt to new challenges.
* Should be prolific in all Microsoft packages like Excel, PowerPoint, MS word, etc.


**What We Offer:**
* Impact: Be part of a team that directly contributes to global operations.
* Opportunity: Unlock professional and personal growth through diverse career pathways.

title: Quality Expert - Payment Posting
description:
**Company Description** 
 IKS Health helps healthcare work better for clinicians, organizations, and the patients they serve by combining technology, AI, and deep healthcare expertise. The company’s platform connects data, systems, and workflows to streamline clinical, financial, administrative, and operational tasks using intelligent automation and human judgment. IKS Health supports 150,000 clinicians and more than 900 healthcare organizations across the United States, including specialty groups, community hospitals, and large health systems. Its services span clinical documentation, coding, revenue cycle management, patient access, care management, and operational support to reduce friction and strengthen financial performance. The vision of IKS Health is successful healthcare for all, with healthier communities, more satisfied clinicians, and thriving organizations.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Quality Expert – Payment Posting is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Chennai. This role focuses on monitoring and validating payment posting activities to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence to client and organizational standards. The Quality Expert will review posted payments, adjustments, and denials, identify discrepancies, and provide clear feedback and guidance to payment posting teams. The role also involves preparing quality reports, maintaining documentation, and supporting compliance with internal quality systems and healthcare revenue cycle requirements.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to review payment data, identify patterns, and resolve discrepancies.
* Candidates should possess Quality Control skills to audit payment posting work and verify adherence to defined standards.
* Candidates should possess Quality Assurance and Quality Management skills to implement and monitor quality initiatives and process improvements.
* Candidates should possess familiarity with Quality System practices to maintain documentation, follow protocols, and support compliance.
* Knowledge of healthcare revenue cycle and payment posting processes, including EOBs, denials, and adjustments.
* Proficiency in MS Office tools and relevant billing or practice management systems.
* Strong communication skills, attention to detail, and ability to work collaboratively in a team\-based environment.
* Prior experience in healthcare quality or payment posting, and a bachelor’s degree in a related field (such as commerce, healthcare administration, or business) are preferred.

title: Asset Information Specialist
description:
**The Opportunity**
 As a member of the LCI team, you will be at the forefront of our efforts to coordinate all activities related to Asset Information Management (AIM) and Data Quality. Your main responsibility will be to support project execution and ensure that LCI coordination is carried out effectively across all phases of a project, from tendering to final handover to the client. Furthermore, you will work closely with the BIM (Building Information Modelling) team to ensure that we have a structured and collaborative approach towards data handling and data insertion in the BIM 3D models.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Develop, implement, and maintain LCI strategies, standards, and procedures in alignment with company policies and industry best practices.
* Manage the collection, organization, and validation of LCI from various sources, including engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning teams.
* Ensure the timely and accurate handover of LCI to operations and maintenance teams.
* Utilize and administer LCI management systems and tools (e.g., EDMS, PLM systems) to track and control project documentation.
* Conduct quality checks and audits of LCI deliverables to ensure compliance with project requirements and data integrity.
* Collaborate with project teams, vendors, and stakeholders to resolve LCI\-related issues and discrepancies.
* Provide training and support to project personnel on LCI processes and tools.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of LCI management processes and systems.
* Prepare and present LCI status reports to project management and relevant stakeholders.
* Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your Background**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information management, or a related field. Advanced degree or certification in asset management or data analytics is a plus.
* Candidate should have 7 to12 years of experience in Life Cycle Information (LCI) and Asset Information Management (AIM).
* In\-depth knowledge of LCI/AIM systems, technologies, and asset management frameworks.
* Familiarity with industry standards and best practices related to asset information management.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced project environment.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with diverse teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Knowledge of relevant industry standards and regulations related to information management is a plus.

title: Enterprise App Admin II
description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.
   

  

 Living our values everyday results in our team\-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.
   

  

**About Five9**
 Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 brings the power of AI and cloud innovation to customer experience software worldwide.
   

  

 Living our values drives our team\-first culture, helping us innovate, grow, and thrive together.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking an HR Applications Administrator to join our Business Technology / Enterprise Applications team, responsible for administering, configuring, and supporting the applications behind Five9’s HR, Payroll, and Talent programs, primarily UKG (formerly UltiPro), with additional support for Deel, Greenhouse, and various other HR applications. This role partners closely with Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Business Technology, InfoSec, and external vendors to keep our HR systems secure, reliable, and effective.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has hands\-on UKG administration experience, along with a UKG Pro certification, strongly preferred. Candidates with substantial Workday administration experience and a Workday certification may also be a strong fit. This person communicates clearly, partners well across HR, Payroll, Finance, Business Technology, InfoSec, and vendor teams, and manages day\-to\-day administration independently.
   

  

 The position is a hybrid role combining in\-office and work\-from\-home days, based in Chennai or Bengaluru, India, and requires regular overlap with United States business hours, including work until approximately 11:30 PM India Standard Time when needed.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Administer and configure Five9’s HR applications on a day\-to\-day basis, with primary focus on UKG Pro (formerly UltiPro), including system settings, business rules, and module configuration
* Maintain system security roles, permissions, and access controls across HR applications to ensure appropriate data protection and compliance with company policy
* Build, test, and maintain business process workflows, approval chains, and notifications within UKG Pro and related HR systems
* Support and maintain integrations between UKG Pro, Deel, Greenhouse, Degreed Learning Experience Platform, Replicon, and other business applications, partnering with Business Technology teams as needed
* Perform system testing, including validation of configuration changes, patches, and vendor releases prior to production deployment
* Coordinate periodic vendor releases and platform updates, assessing impact to existing configuration and coordinating regression testing with stakeholders
* Monitor data quality across HR systems, and identify, troubleshoot, and resolve data integrity issues
* Build and maintain reports and dashboards to support HR, Payroll, and business stakeholder reporting needs
* Maintain clear, current documentation of system configurations, processes, and support procedures
* Provide day\-to\-day user support and troubleshooting for HR application end users, resolving issues in a timely manner
* Manage vendor relationships for supported HR applications, including support tickets, escalations, and roadmap discussions
* Support the AI Center of Excellence by identifying and helping implement opportunities to leverage AI to automate hire\-to\-retire and payroll\-related processes
* Partner with Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Business Technology, and InfoSec teams to gather requirements and implement solutions that meet business needs


**Qualifications \& Skills**
**Required Qualifications**
* A minimum of 5 years of experience administering enterprise Human Resources applications, with hands\-on UKG Pro (formerly UltiPro) experience as the primary qualification
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Experience managing security roles, permissions, and access controls within an HRIS platform
* Experience building and maintaining business process workflows, approval chains, and notifications
* Experience supporting integrations between HR systems and other enterprise applications
* Experience with system testing, including validating configuration changes and vendor releases prior to production deployment
* Experience monitoring and maintaining data quality and data integrity across HR systems
* Experience building reports and dashboards to support HR and business reporting needs
* Strong documentation skills, with the ability to maintain clear and current process and configuration documentation
* Experience providing end\-user support and troubleshooting for HR applications
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Business Technology, InfoSec, and external vendors
* Experience managing vendor relationships, including support escalations and coordination on releases


**Preferred Qualifications**
* UKG Pro certification (strongly preferred)
* Workday certification, for candidates whose primary HRIS administration experience is with Workday
* Deel certification preferred
* Experience with Greenhouse, Degreed Learning Experience Platform, or Replicon desired
* Experience administering another major Human Resources Information System, supported by relevant qualifications or certifications


**Why You’ll Love This Role**
* You will play a key role in supporting and evolving the technology that powers Five9’s HR, Payroll, and Talent programs
* You will work hands\-on with UKG Pro and gain exposure to a broader ecosystem of leading HR platforms
* You will use cutting\-edge technologies, including AI, to help create great employee experiences
* You will build strong partnerships across Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Business Technology, InfoSec, and vendor teams
* If you enjoy solving practical problems, safeguarding data quality, and delivering excellent support to HR technology users, this role offers strong opportunities to grow your HRIS expertise


 Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.  The more inclusive we are, the better we are.  Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.
   

  

 View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9\.com/pt\-pt/legal.
